# `spawnables/SpawnableItem.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/spawnables/SpawnableItem.js`

SpawnableItem - Base class for all spawnable objects in the editor. Physics collider options: - Override getCollider() to define custom colliders - Use helper imports from EditorPhysics for advanced physics: - generateCollidersFromSDF(sdfFunc, bounds, resolution) - createMeshColliderDecomposed(vertices, indices, options) - createSDFCollider(sdfFunc, bounds, options) - createVoxelCollider(voxels, sizeX, sizeY, sizeZ, voxelSize) ```js import { generateCollidersFromSDF } from '../../modules/EditorPhysics.js'; static getCollider() { return { shape: 'box', halfExtents: [0.01, 0.01, 0.01], compoundColliders: generateCollidersFromSDF( (x, y, z) => mySDF(x, y, z), { min: [-1, -1, -1], max: [1, 1, 1] }, 12 ), }; } ```

## Classes

### `class SpawnableItem`

SpawnableItem - Base class for all spawnable objects in the editor. Physics collider options: - Override getCollider() to define custom colliders - Use helper imports from EditorPhysics for advanced physics: - generateCollidersFromSDF(sdfFunc, bounds, resolution) - createMeshColliderDecomposed(vertices, indices, options) - createSDFCollider(sdfFunc, bounds, options) - createVoxelCollider(voxels, sizeX, sizeY, sizeZ, voxelSize) ```js import { generateCollidersFromSDF } from '../../modules/EditorPhysics.js'; static getCollider() { return { shape: 'box', halfExtents: [0.01, 0.01, 0.01], compoundColliders: generateCollidersFromSDF( (x, y, z) => mySDF(x, y, z), { min: [-1, -1, -1], max: [1, 1, 1] }, 12 ), }; } ```

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `getGeometry` | `static getGeometry()` | Get geometry for rendering. |
| `getCollider` | `static getCollider()` | Get physics collider configuration. Override this to provide custom colliders for complex shapes. Supported shapes: - box: { shape: 'box', halfExtents: [x, y, z] } - sphere: { shape: 'sphere', radius: r } - capsule: { shape: 'capsule', radius: r, halfHeight: h } - convexMesh: { shape: 'convexMesh', meshId: id, vertices: [...] } - compound: { shape: 'box', halfExtents: [...], compoundColliders: [...] } |
| `getDefaultComponents` | `static getDefaultComponents()` | Get default ECS components for this spawnable. |
| `getColor` | `static getColor()` | Get default color for this spawnable. Override to provide a custom color. |
| `spawn` | `static spawn(editor, position)` | Spawn this item in the editor at the given position. |
| `getSDF` | `static getSDF()` | Optional: Get SDF function for this shape. Used for particle collision, soft-body interaction, etc. |
| `getArticulation` | `static getArticulation()` | Optional: Get articulation configuration for jointed objects. Used for ropes, chains, ragdolls. |
| `getPhysicalMaterial` | `static getPhysicalMaterial()` | Optional: Get default physical material preset key for this shape. Used to auto-populate the PhysicalMaterial ECS component on spawn. Override in subclasses for shape-appropriate defaults. |

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```

**See also:** [Editor Overview](/editor/overview.md)
